g.text: Component View: Deployed service - Cloud Run service
Everything inside the one container, and two facts prose has to work hard to
say. Both the arithmetic tool and the save tool call the same validation chain,
which is why the store's answer is trustworthy and the agent's claim is not. And
the document guard sits between the agent and the model, not in front of the
endpoint. The Pydantic models are types, so they are named on the arrows rather
